## Workflow package

**[Watch the full video tutorial on how to use the workflow](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=t4cwY4u5UUU).**

Create Hearts of Iron IV-style leader portraits with ComfyUI, the distilled FLUX.2 Klein 9B model, and the project's 2500-step HOI4 style LoRA.

The package contains four workflows:

- **Source portrait** — prepare a photograph, optionally restore it with the complete Adonis Base → Post path, and create a HOI4-style portrait.
- **Text to image** — create a fictional portrait from a written description.
- **Batch** — process a folder one image at a time, choose how many candidates to create, and keep each run in its own numbered output folder.
- **Portrait processing** — crop, upscale, and optionally restore a source image without applying the HOI4 style LoRA.

Full, FP8, and GGUF installs all use distilled FLUX.2 Klein 9B weights and keep the 2500-step HOI4 style LoRA plus Adonis Base, Refine, and Post. Every workflow saves a full-resolution PNG, a 156×210 PNG, and a HOI4-ready DDS.

## Downloads

- **Model-free ZIP** — workflows, guides, installers, custom nodes, and bundled assets.
- **Windows x64 installer** — detects your GPU, helps you choose a suitable model, offers to install ComfyUI when it is missing, and lets you choose local or custom input and output folders.
- **RunPod runtime archive** — installs the same workflows and dependencies on an existing ComfyUI pod.

## Before installation

Accept the Hugging Face agreement for the [full FLUX.2 Klein 9B model](https://huggingface.co/black-forest-labs/FLUX.2-klein-9B) or the [FP8 FLUX.2 Klein 9B model](https://huggingface.co/black-forest-labs/FLUX.2-klein-9b-fp8), then create a [read-only Hugging Face token](https://huggingface.co/settings/tokens/new?tokenType=read). GGUF does not require a token.

## RunPod installation

> **Starting on RunPod? [Use my referral link](https://runpod.io/?ref=9t44ghaf) when creating a new account. You get $5 free once you add $10.**

Run this in a Jupyter terminal on the pod:

```bash
(
set -euo pipefail
export HF_TOKEN="hf_..."
COMFY_ROOT=/workspace/runpod-slim/ComfyUI
RUNTIME_DIR=/workspace/hoi4-portrait-runpod
test -f "$COMFY_ROOT/main.py" || { echo "ComfyUI not found at $COMFY_ROOT; set COMFY_ROOT to the folder containing main.py."; exit 1; }
mkdir -p "$RUNTIME_DIR"
curl -fsSL "https://github.com/klimPaskov/comfyui-hoi4-portraits/releases/latest/download/HOI4-Portrait-RunPod.tar.gz" | tar -xz -C "$RUNTIME_DIR"
"$RUNTIME_DIR/scripts/install_runpod.sh" "$COMFY_ROOT" --variant fp8
)
```

Restart ComfyUI, then open a workflow from **Workflows → hoi4_portraits**. Put batch sources in `/workspace/hoi4-portrait-runpod/input/`; PNG and DDS results are saved below `/workspace/hoi4-portrait-runpod/output/`. The default FP8 installation requires at least 25 GB of storage. Use `--variant full` to select full BF16 explicitly or `--variant gguf --gguf-quants Q5_K_M` for a smaller GPU.

For SCP, `.tar.gz`, and JupyterLab download methods, see the [RunPod output download instructions](https://github.com/klimPaskov/comfyui-hoi4-portraits/blob/v1.0.2/docs/download-outputs.md).
